name: jobee
description: Jobee — personal AI job-search and application management platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "api,worker,web" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build:packages: npm run --workspace=@job-agent/shared build && npm run --workspace=@job-agent/config build && npm run --workspace=@job-agent/database build
scripts.build:apps: npm run --workspace=@job-agent/api build && npm run --workspace=@job-agent/worker build && npm run --workspace=@job-agent/web build
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.typecheck:packages: npm run --workspace=@job-agent/shared typecheck && npm run --workspace=@job-agent/config typecheck && npm run --workspace=@job-agent/database typecheck
scripts.typecheck:apps: npm run --workspace=@job-agent/api typecheck && npm run --workspace=@job-agent/worker typecheck && npm run --workspace=@job-agent/web typecheck
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck:packages && npm run typecheck:apps
